limitations: Finite controls and limited same-build emitted review do not establish universal malformed-geometry, bottom/error equivalence or complete codec qualification.

Whole writer and segmented writer are separate executions; do not add/subtract windows as exclusive costs or extrapolate these percentages to total compiler savings.
Action closure creation is outside observations, return-value forcing changes boundaries and execution order changes warm state.
